tagline: A hands-on, role-based curriculum for engineers who build and train machine-learning models — from your first production model to principal-level ML strategy.
overview: This org covers **ML engineering** — *building and training* the models: data pipelines, classical and deep learning, fine-tuning and alignment, evaluation, distributed training, and the senior-to-principal work of setting ML architecture and strategy. Every role track has a paired **learning** repository (modules, lecture chapters, exercises) and a **solutions** repository with reference walkthroughs.
highlights: 🧭 Ladder runs from **ML Engineer (L20)** to **Principal ML Engineer (L48)**, with four specialist tracks in between

focus.ml-engineer: ML foundations, data for ML, classical & deep learning, experiment tracking, deployment, drift monitoring
focus.fine-tuning-engineer: SFT data, PEFT (LoRA/QLoRA), preference optimization, safety tuning, distributed fine-tuning, quantization
focus.model-evaluation-engineer: Benchmarks, LLM eval harnesses, LLM-as-judge, human eval, agent & safety evals, production eval
focus.nlp-engineer: Tokenization, classical NLP, classification, extraction, QA, summarization, machine translation
focus.senior-ml-engineer: ML systems architecture, production LLM integration, experimentation at scale, ML SLOs, technical leadership
focus.training-pipeline-engineer: Distributed training, data pipelines at scale, cluster orchestration, checkpointing, elastic training, throughput
focus.staff-ml-engineer: Multi-team ML architecture, foundation-model training programs, ML platform strategy, capacity & TCO
focus.principal-ml-engineer: Org & industry ML strategy, north-star ML architecture, influence without authority, the technical bar

track_note: Specialist tracks (fine-tuning, evaluation, NLP, training pipelines) branch from ML Engineer and can be taken in any order.

technologies.Distributed training: FSDP, DeepSpeed, Megatron, NCCL, CUDA, Triton
technologies.Evaluation: Benchmark harnesses, LLM-as-judge, human evaluation, red-team evals
